Is the fear of heights innate or learned? Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, and Gary O'Reilly explore taking risks, the neuroscience of fear, and how to overcome it with Alex Honnold, freestyle rock climber, subject of the film Free Solo, and Host of Planet Visionaries: in partnership with the Rolex Perpetual Planet Initiative as well as neuroscientist Heather Berlin. 

We start with Alex Honnold, the only person ever to free solo Yosemite’s El Capitan, and how he approaches a big climb. Has he ever gotten scared or shaken? Did he ever have a fear of heights? Alex breaks down what free soloing actually means and what he does to mentally prepare himself for taking on big challenges. How does he expand his comfort zone?
